title: Bourke Court House
geometryBasis: The courthouse exterior outline and enclosed garden court are tied to the named outdoor footprint, with pavilions and porch recesses inferred from archive photographs.
sectionBasis: Original photographs show the open square corner turret, raised slate courtroom with paired hooded roof vents, semicircular upper windows, verandahs and scalloped courtyard walls. The state heritage register records the rough cast render over brick, face brick and slate.
limitations: The old photographs record the architectural form and the heritage register records later restoration. Roof pitches, small rear volumes and brick and render colors are estimates.
The national elevation source resolves broad grade. Individual steps and courtyard paving levels are estimated.
